question: In which year did India organise the Asian Games for the second time?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1982.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India organized the **Asian Games** for the second time in the year **1982**.
 
• The games were held in **New Delhi**, the capital city of India.
 
• The mascot for the 1982 Asian Games was **Appu**, an elephant, symbolizing strength, speed, and a friendly nature.
 
• India finished fifth in the medal tally, securing
 
 
• **13 gold**,
 
• **19 silver**, and
 
• **25 bronze** medals.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Event
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **First Asian Games**
 India hosted the inaugural Asian Games in **1951**, also in New Delhi.
 
 

 **Asian Games Purpose**
 A multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia, aiming to foster unity and cooperation.
 
 

 **Asian Games Federation**
 The body responsible for the governance and organization of the Asian Games.
 
 

 **Impact on Indian Sports**
 The successful organization of the Asian Games significantly boosted the development of sports infrastructure in India.
 
 

 **Future Hosting**
 India's experience and legacy of hosting the Asian Games have been instrumental in its bids for other international sporting events.
